candidate_microdirections.name: receipt_bound_gate_admission
candidate_microdirections.question: Can gate state be made proof-carrying so workflow definition, execution, receipt verification and admission cannot collapse into one status?
candidate_microdirections.falsifier: A current production gate already binds executed run, exact subject/material digests, scope and verified receipt strongly enough to reject all stale/missing/mismatched cases.

candidate_microdirections.name: semantic_hash_domain_separation

candidate_microdirections.name: grammar_upgrade_semantic_stability

candidate_microdirections.falsifier: A production differential already proves this across all currently admitted grammar generations.

candidate_microdirections.name: workflow_receipt_stale_head_race
